$commentFirstAttack: P3-12 (PLY-11, 2026-11-18): the tutorial's forced first raid used to end the 24-hour new-player shield silently; a village's first attack keeps it (sim/shield.ts, also server/core/pvp.ts).

newPlayerRaids.$comment: The first `count` bot raids a village ever faces (after the new-player shield) bring a smaller, less researched army, so a new village with its first Kunai Tower usually holds (sim/defense.ts attackerFor).

defenseWin.$comment: Every star a raid fails to win pays the defender a third of this share of its Keep's lowest generated raid loot, in Coins and Provisions (storage-capped; what did not fit is reported). P2-01 (DEF-01, 2026-11-18): was 0.05 for a full hold only; 0.10 since the 2026-11-20 merge (0.12 paid a maxed Keep 15 base 20% of a regular player's daily raid loot, 0.10 about 17%: daily_live.ts in docs/audit/understand-2026-11-16/scripts/defense-raids). Simulated raids only: a real player's raid pays honor, never this.

$commentCarry: P2-01 (DEF-01): a bot raider carries home this share of what it broke open, by stars won (0-3), so every star a defence denies keeps loot in the village. Raids by real players keep conservation (the defender loses what the attacker carries).
$commentRaider: P2-02 (DEF-04): bot raiders come from the defender's own Keep (a strength drawn between Keep-2 and Keep-1, which is a Keep - 1 raider at some level bias; independent review 2026-11-18 corrected 'Keep-1 to Keep'), not from honor, so holding raids no longer summons a stronger raider.
$commentRaiderMatchByKeep: Beast Mode GT-05 (2026-11-23): from Keep 10 simulated raiders come from Keep-1.5 to Keep-0.5, from Keep 12 from Keep-2.5 to Keep-1.5. A regular player who builds the counters first held 3% of the raids at Keeps 12-15 (every raider a near-capped army of its own Keep); measured 17% with this (3 seeds). Simulated raids only: real players attack as they are.

rematch.$comment: Settle the score: once per bot raid, within `windowHours`, attack the raider's own generated base. No loot from buildings and no honor; a win (1+ stars) pays `shareOfRaidLoot` x stars/3 of the Keep's lowest raid loot.
rematch.$commentRecover: P2-07 (DEF-08, 2026-11-18): a win also pays back recoverShare x stars/3 of what that raid took, per resource, when larger (three stars at Keep 12 paid 437k against a 607k army). 1.0, not the suggested 0.75: after P2-01 raiders take less, and 0.75 paid 0.46-0.81 of a normal raid at Keeps 10-12. Never more than the raid took, so losing on purpose stays a loss.

exhaustion.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (exhausted stores): each raid the village lost (1+ star) in the last windowHours multiplies what the next raider can take by factor, offline and online. P2-06 (DEF-11, 2026-11-18): window 24 -> 36 hours, so raids a day apart on a once-a-day player are caught.

diversity.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (diversity carries more): a won raid carries minShare + (1 - minShare) x min(1, D / fullAt) of its loot, D = 1 - sum of squared housing shares by role of the warriors that fought (the hero not counted).
diversity.$commentRoles: P2-15 (UIS-07, 2026-11-18): full carry while the village can train fewer than fullBelowRoles roles (at Dojo 1 only Shinobi: the first raid used to say 85%).

stakes.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (declared stakes, opt-in): before a raid the attacker may declare 2 or 3 stars; reaching it carries the loot x byStars[stake], missing it carries nothing and a real defender keeps it. Without a declaration a raid carries its loot as before.
stakes.$commentP208: P2-08 (DEF-09, 2026-11-18): 1.1/1.25 -> 1.3/1.75 (break-even hit rates 91%/80% -> 77%/57%). Regular campaign, raid-weighted Keeps 5-15, bot plan: two-star stake 0.78 of not declaring (a skill bet), gains only at Keeps 5 and 9; a player who hits two stars four times in five gets 1.04.
stakes.$commentMinKeep: Beast Mode GT-10: stakes open from Keep 6. Below it the regular player three-stars about two raids in three (Keep 2: 66%), so a 3-star stake paid 1.15x on average: free money. From Keep 6 the farming gate holds three-stars under half (x1.75 < 0.88).

$commentShieldP301: P3-01 (PAC-01, 2026-11-18): shield hours 12/14/16 -> 16/20/24, measured together with economy.collectorHoursCap and raidableUncollectedFraction.
$commentCatchUp: P2-05 (DEF-06, 2026-11-18): at most this many raids in one catch-up after an absence (was 24: thirty days away emptied 94-97% of what was stored).
$commentResume: Exploit audit 2026-11-16 (XPL-02): an interrupted Bounty Hunt attack or rematch still counts as begun when its record says for battleResumeHours after it would have ended; an older record is refused (the record's time is the game's to send).
$commentRaiderMixes: P2-03 (DEF-05, 2026-11-18): alternates beside botArmyMix per raider Keep (index = Keep - 1): an air raid and a shadow and siege raid, picked with today's line by the raid's seed (attackerFor). Keeps 1-6 keep today's line only.
$commentContracts: P5-03 (RET-11, 2026-11-18): one contract a UTC day, the same for everyone (list[day mod 6]); it changes only what a won raid carries home, never the battle. carryCap: contract x stake x diversity x event bonus never carries more than 2.2x the plain loot (tests/gameplay/sim/contracts.test.ts).
